//: Dinger Watch model config. Deep-merged over the app defaults at load, so this survives any rebuild of index.html. Delete any key to fall back to its default. Place next to index.html.
// regression: SMALL-SAMPLE REGRESSION for DERIVED Statcast only (real measured Statcast is untouched). regressionPA is the plate-appearance count at which a player's own rate and the league average are weighted equally — raise it to trust small samples less, lower it to let hot callups rank higher. lowSamplePA is the threshold below which cards show a "small sample" warning.
// grading: GRADES. mode 'percentile' grades on RANK within tonight's slate — percentiles.aPlus:95 means only the top 5% get A+. Raise it to make A+ rarer, lower it to hand out more. mode 'absolute' uses the fixed probability thresholds in cuts instead.
// hr: HOME RUN INDEX (0-100). weights must total 100. Each *Scale is the input value that earns full marks.
// hits: PROJECTED HITS. babipWeight pulls a lucky/unlucky hitter back toward .300 (0 disables). kSensitivity weights the batter-vs-pitcher strikeout mismatch.
// order: BATTING ORDER multipliers, index 0 = leadoff. Applied only when MLB has posted the lineup.
// steal: STEAL OPPORTUNITY. Below successFloor, managers stop sending the runner and the projection is damped.
// tb: PROJECTED TOTAL BASES = expected AB x blended SLG x park x weather.
// rbi: PROJECTED RBI = season RBI/game x park run environment x recent form.
// hrr: H+R+RBI. Components projected separately and summed, matching the sportsbook market.
// sb: STOLEN BASE speed score. posBonus shifts by position.
